issue: M60 relationship-ontology wave — CLJ-D59 (`nil` is a type)
note: `(extend-protocol P nil (m [_] …))` extends P to `nil`, and `nil` parses as a `nil_lit` rather than a `sym_lit`. The method-impl owner reader walked back for a `sym_lit`, skipped the `nil_lit`, and landed on the protocol head — so the method was attributed to the protocol it implements. Measured over the 633-file corpus that published `overrides P.m -> P.m`, 8 self-edges and 4.30% of the type, and it also cost the `implements nil -> P` edge and the `contains` edge entirely. `(satisfies? P nil)` is true, so `nil` is a real dispatch target: the endpoints are facts about the source. The `nil` endpoints name no var the file interns, which is the same position `String` and `java.util.Date` already hold and is declared as a limitation rather than hidden.
